description: Updated prompt list for word-level TAM/scanpath comparison. Removes the bathroom-specific bias prompt, keeps one misleading prompt, removes redundant stress prompts, and adds one verified ObjDetection prompt used by the colleague.

notes.scope: Use this list for the new word-level comparative analysis.
notes.removed_from_v2: strong_bias_prior_stress was removed because it is too specific to bathroom scenes. contradictory_false_presupposition and lexical_ablation_visible_object were removed to keep the comparison lighter and less redundant.
notes.template_note: The colleague prompt contains {obj_main}; it must be filled with the target object for the selected image before running.

prompts.label: image_grounded_visible_only
prompts.prompt: Describe the image using only directly visible details in one sentence.

prompts.label: ambiguous_open
prompts.prompt: What is happening in the image?

prompts.label: misleading_wrong_subject
prompts.prompt: Describe the dog in the image.

prompts.label: extra_knowledge_context
prompts.prompt: Describe the image and the likely function of the main visible object.

prompts.label: reasoning_controlled_brief
prompts.prompt: Identify the main visible object and briefly explain why it is the most relevant.

prompts.label: order_disruption_stress
prompts.prompt: Describe only visible details in image.

verified_but_not_included.reason: Not included in the main list because the current request asks for one colleague prompt.
